package.name: iad_calibration
package.description: Standalone multi-LiDAR extrinsic calibration while driving: ground-plane fit (roll, pitch, z) and mapping-based point-to-plane registration against the reference LiDAR's accumulated map (yaw, x, y), followed by a joint 6-DOF refinement. In: sensor_msgs/PointCloud2 per LiDAR, nav_msgs/Odometry, nominal extrinsics on /tf_static. Out: estimated extrinsics (YAML + JSON), TF calib/*, corrected clouds.
